records.subject: spec-guard-codex
evidence: command:edit the `ref` line of [marketplaces.spec-guard-marketplace] in ~/.codex/config.toml from v0.44.0 to v0.45.0
result:the upgrade exited 0 and `codex plugin list --json` reports spec-guard 0.45.0, installed and enabled

limit:the first upgrade attempt exited 127 because this session's PATH no longer contained codex; it was rerun with /Applications/ChatGPT.app/Contents/Resources/codex-cli/bin/codex (codex-cli 0.160.0), the same CLI used for earlier releases

records.subject: spec-guard-codex-cli-smoke
evidence: result:the smoke exited 0 and its machine session record contained a valid Spec Guard phase injection
result:--expected-source was taken verbatim from the source.path reported by `codex plugin list --json`

records.subject: spec-guard-codex-cost-report
evidence: command:cd <ledgerlite run X-N1> && codex exec --json --sandbox read-only -c 'model="gpt-6.1-sol"' -c 'model_reasoning_effort="medium"' '用 spec-guard 的 cost report 看看 ledgerlite 这个模块花了多少钱，价格文件用 <tier-guard price basis>。把报告原样给我，不要改任何文件。' </dev/null

result:the session read the installed 0.45.0 spec-guard-ops SKILL.md, resolved the plugin root through `codex plugin list --available --json`, and ran the installed hooks/module_cost_report.py under ~/.codex/.tmp/marketplaces/spec-guard-marketplace/plugins/spec-guard

result:the report it returned gave the total including wrap-up as $0.7445 for X-N1, equal to this repository's figure and to tier-guard's independent whole-run figure ($0.745), with the unknowns section intact
result:read-only sandbox; the project's worktree was clean afterwards
